verses.original: וּזְכֹר֙ אֶת־ בּ֣וֹרְאֶ֔יךָ בִּימֵ֖י בְּחוּרֹתֶ֑יךָ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ יָבֹ֙אוּ֙ יְמֵ֣י הָֽרָעָ֔ה וְהִגִּ֣יעוּ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר אֵֽין־ לִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם חֵֽפֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·ḵōr ’eṯ- bō·wr·’e·ḵā bî·mê bə·ḥū·rō·ṯe·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḇō·’ū yə·mê hā·rā·‘āh wə·hig·gî·‘ū šā·nîm ’ă·šer tō·mar ’ên- lî ḇā·hem ḥê·p̄eṣ
verses.literal: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth before - the days of adversity come and the years approach of which you will say I find no pleasure in them
verses.literalPt: LEMBRA-TE também do teu Criador nos dias da tua mocidade, antes que venham os maus dias, e cheguem os anos dos quais venhas a dizer: Não tenho neles contentamento;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ תֶחְשַׁ֤ךְ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וְהָא֔וֹר וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ וְהַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים וְשָׁ֥בוּ הֶעָבִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ’ă·šer lō- ṯeḥ·šaḵ haš·še·meš wə·hā·’ō·wr wə·hay·yā·rê·aḥ wə·hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm wə·šā·ḇū he·‘ā·ḇîm ’a·ḥar hag·gā·šem
verses.literal: before - the light of the sun moon and stars is darkened and the clouds return after the rain
verses.literalPt: Antes que se escureçam o sol, e a luz, e a lua, e as estrelas, e tornem a vir as nuvens depois da chuva;

verses.original: בַּיּ֗וֹם שֶׁיָּזֻ֙עוּ֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וְהִֽתְעַוְּת֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל וּבָטְל֤וּ הַטֹּֽחֲנוֹת֙ כִּ֣י מִעֵ֔טוּ וְחָשְׁכ֥וּ הָרֹא֖וֹת בָּאֲרֻבּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm še·yā·zu·‘ū šō·mə·rê hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hiṯ·‘aw·wə·ṯū ’an·šê he·ḥā·yil ū·ḇā·ṭə·lū haṭ·ṭō·ḥă·nō·wṯ kî mi·‘ê·ṭū wə·ḥā·šə·ḵū hā·rō·’ō·wṯ bā·’ă·rub·bō·wṯ
verses.literal: on the day the keepers of the house tremble and the strong men stoop when those grinding cease because they are few and those watching through windows see dimly
verses.literalPt: No dia em que tremerem os guardas da casa, e se encurvarem os homens fortes, e cessarem os moedores, por já serem poucos, e se escurecerem os que olham pelas janelas;

verses.original: וְסֻגְּר֤וּ דְלָתַ֙יִם֙ בַּשּׁ֔וּק בִּשְׁפַ֖ל ק֣וֹל הַֽטַּחֲנָ֑ה וְיָקוּם֙ לְק֣וֹל הַצִּפּ֔וֹר וְיִשַּׁ֖חוּ כָּל־ בְּנ֥וֹת הַשִּֽׁיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sug·gə·rū ḏə·lā·ṯa·yim baš·šūq biš·p̄al qō·wl haṭ·ṭa·ḥă·nāh wə·yā·qūm lə·qō·wl haṣ·ṣip·pō·wr wə·yiš·ša·ḥū kāl- bə·nō·wṯ haš·šîr
verses.literal: when the doors to the street are shut and the sound of the mill fades away when one rises at the sound of a bird and all the daughters of song grow faint
verses.literalPt: E as portas da rua se fecharem por causa do baixo ruído da moedura, e se levantar à voz das aves, e todas as filhas da música se abaterem.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מִגָּבֹ֤הַּ יִרָ֙אוּ֙ וְחַתְחַתִּ֣ים בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְיָנֵ֤אץ הַשָּׁקֵד֙ וְיִסְתַּבֵּ֣ל הֶֽחָגָ֔ב וְתָפֵ֖ר הָֽאֲבִיּוֹנָ֑ה כִּֽי־ הֹלֵ֤ךְ הָאָדָם֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית עוֹלָמ֔וֹ וְסָבְב֥וּ בָשּׁ֖וּק הַסֹּפְדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam mig·gā·ḇō·ah yi·rā·’ū wə·ḥaṯ·ḥat·tîm bad·de·reḵ wə·yā·nêṣ haš·šā·qêḏ wə·yis·tab·bêl he·ḥā·ḡāḇ wə·ṯā·p̄êr hā·’ă·ḇî·yō·w·nāh kî- hō·lêḵ hā·’ā·ḏām ’el- bêṯ ‘ō·w·lā·mōw wə·sā·ḇə·ḇū ḇå̄š·šūq has·sō·p̄ə·ḏîm
verses.literal: when men fear the heights and dangers of the road when the almond tree blossoms the grasshopper loses its spring and the caper berry shrivels for then man goes to his eternal home and mourners walk the streets
verses.literalPt: Como também quando temerem o que é alto, e houver espantos no caminho, e florescer a amendoeira, e o gafanhoto for um peso, e perecer o apetite; porque o homem se vai à sua casa eterna, e os pranteadores andarão rodeando pela praça;

verses.original: עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִרְחַק חֶ֣בֶל הַכֶּ֔סֶף וְתָרֻ֖ץ גֻּלַּ֣ת הַזָּהָ֑ב וְתִשָּׁ֤בֶר כַּד֙ עַל־ הַמַּבּ֔וּעַ וְנָרֹ֥ץ הַגַּלְגַּ֖ל אֶל־ הַבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ’ă·šer lō- yir·ḥaq ḥe·ḇel hak·ke·sep̄ wə·ṯā·ruṣ gul·laṯ haz·zā·hāḇ wə·ṯiš·šā·ḇer kaḏ ‘al- ham·mab·bū·a‘ wə·nā·rōṣ hag·gal·gal ’el- hab·bō·wr
verses.literal: Remember Him before - the silver cord is snapped and the golden bowl is crushed before the pitcher is shattered at the spring and the wheel is broken at the well
verses.literalPt: Antes que se rompa o cordão de prata, e se quebre o copo de ouro, e se despedace o cântaro junto à fonte, e se quebre a roda junto ao poço,

verses.original: וְיָשֹׁ֧ב הֶעָפָ֛ר עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּשֶׁהָיָ֑ה וְהָר֣וּחַ תָּשׁ֔וּב אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְתָנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šōḇ he·‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ kə·še·hā·yāh wə·hā·rū·aḥ tā·šūḇ ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer nə·ṯā·nāh
verses.literal: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it
verses.literalPt: E o pó volte à terra, como o era, e o espírito volte a Deus, que o deu.

verses.original: הֲבֵ֧ל הֲבָלִ֛ים אָמַ֥ר הַקּוֹהֶ֖לֶת הַכֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל׃
verses.literal: Futility of futilities says the Teacher Everything is futile
verses.literalPt: Vaidade de vaidades, diz o pregador, tudo é vaidade.

verses.original: וְיֹתֵ֕ר שֶׁהָיָ֥ה קֹהֶ֖לֶת חָכָ֑ם ע֗וֹד לִמַּד־ דַּ֙עַת֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וְאִזֵּ֣ן וְחִקֵּ֔ר תִּקֵּ֖ן מְשָׁלִ֥ים הַרְבֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·ṯêr še·hā·yāh qō·he·leṯ ḥā·ḵām ‘ō·wḏ lim·maḏ- da·‘aṯ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wə·’iz·zên wə·ḥiq·qêr tiq·qên mə·šā·lîm har·bêh
verses.literal: Not only was the Teacher wise but he also taught the people knowledge he pondered searched out and arranged many proverbs
verses.literalPt: E, quanto mais sábio foi o pregador, tanto mais ensinou ao povo sabedoria; e atentando, e esquadrinhando, compôs muitos provérbios.

verses.original: בִּקֵּ֣שׁ קֹהֶ֔לֶת לִמְצֹ֖א דִּבְרֵי־ חֵ֑פֶץ וְכָת֥וּב יֹ֖שֶׁר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: biq·qêš qō·he·leṯ lim·ṣō diḇ·rê- ḥê·p̄eṣ wə·ḵā·ṯūḇ yō·šer diḇ·rê ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: The Teacher searched to find delightful sayings and to record accurate words of truth
verses.literalPt: Procurou o pregador achar palavras agradáveis; e escreveu-as com retidão, palavras de verdade.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ כַּדָּ֣רְבֹנ֔וֹת וּֽכְמַשְׂמְר֥וֹת נְטוּעִ֖ים בַּעֲלֵ֣י אֲסֻפּ֑וֹת נִתְּנ֖וּ מֵרֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê ḥă·ḵā·mîm kad·dā·rə·ḇō·nō·wṯ ū·ḵə·maś·mə·rō·wṯ nə·ṭū·‘îm ba·‘ă·lê ’ă·sup·pō·wṯ nit·tə·nū mê·rō·‘eh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: The words of the wise are like goads and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd
verses.literalPt: As palavras dos sábios são como aguilhões, e como pregos, bem fixados pelos mestres das assembléias, que nos foram dadas pelo único Pastor.

verses.original: וְיֹתֵ֥ר מֵהֵ֖מָּה בְּנִ֣י הִזָּהֵ֑ר עֲשׂ֨וֹת סְפָרִ֤ים הַרְבֵּה֙ אֵ֣ין קֵ֔ץ וְלַ֥הַג הַרְבֵּ֖ה יְגִעַ֥ת בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·ṯêr mê·hêm·māh bə·nî hiz·zā·hêr ‘ă·śō·wṯ sə·p̄ā·rîm har·bêh ’ên qêṣ wə·la·haḡ har·bêh yə·ḡi·‘aṯ bā·śār
verses.literal: And by these my son be further warned There is no end to the making of many books and much study wearies the body
verses.literalPt: E, demais disto, filho meu, atenta: não há limite para fazer livros, e o muito estudar é enfado da carne.

verses.original: ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַכֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְאֶת־ מִצְוֺתָ֣יו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי־ זֶ֖ה כָּל־ הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sō·wp̄ dā·ḇār hak·kōl niš·mā‘ ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·rā wə·’eṯ- miṣ·wō·ṯāw šə·mō·wr kî- zeh kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: When all has been heard the conclusion of the matter is this Fear God and keep His commandments because this is the whole duty of man
verses.literalPt: De tudo o que se tem ouvido, o fim é: Teme a Deus, e guarda os seus mandamentos; porque isto é o dever de todo o homem.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶת־ כָּל־ מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־ נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ ט֖וֹב וְאִם־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- kāl- ma·‘ă·śeh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·ḇi ḇə·miš·pāṭ ‘al kāl- ne‘·lām ’im- ṭō·wḇ wə·’im- rā‘
verses.literal: For God will bring every deed into judgment along with every hidden thing whether good or evil
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus há de trazer a juízo toda a obra, e até tudo o que está encoberto, quer seja bom, quer seja mau.
